scope: Exact rational arithmetic supporting the thresholds in C466m; analytic implications, inherited inputs and p(S) are not machine-verified.

checks.name: gamma_shift
checks.justification: |q|>=4 and |1/(2q)|<=1/8 in the logarithmic power-series bound.

checks.name: whole_completion_remainder
checks.justification: Sum of Gamma, fixed shift, polynomial and Euler-logarithm bounds, in units 1/|q|.

checks.name: horizontal_G_derivative
checks.justification: Coefficient of log(v)/sqrt(v), using log(v)>=8/3 and sqrt(v)>=4.

checks.name: growth_envelope
checks.justification: v>=exp(256); weaker rational lower bounds sqrt(v)>2^32 and v>2^64 suffice.

checks.name: second_difference_remainder
checks.justification: At log(r)=65536 use exp(L/2)>2^64; L exp(-L/2) decreases thereafter.

checks.name: compact_second_difference
checks.justification: 2T^2 L exp(-3L/2), T=exp(256); exp(3L/2-512)>2^64 at L=65536, decreasing thereafter.

checks.name: comparable_error
checks.justification: Uniform error divided by kappa*sqrt(r)*log(r); all three terms decrease for r>=R0.

checks.name: local_integral_log_threshold
checks.justification: At L=1024, log(40)+5log(L)<6+50; logarithmic difference has positive derivative.

checks.name: tail_integral_log_threshold
checks.justification: At L=1024, log(256(L+8))<log(512L)<19; difference has positive derivative.
